full_instruction: Calculate breakeven for my debit spread using the supplied values and use the supplied 5-credit debit and 100-credit lower strike.
prefix: Calculate breakeven for my debit spread
work_product: For a same-expiry vertical spread, use net debit d per share. Bull call: long strike K_low, short K_high; expiration breakeven=K_low+d. Bear put: long K_high, short K_low; expiration breakeven=K_high-d. Width W=K_high-K_low>0; max loss=d and max gain=W-d per share, assuming 0<d<W. Multiply profit/loss by contract multiplier and count; include fees in d consistently. Reject unsupported spread structures instead of applying these formulas.
